prompt.project_info: Create a realistic nostalgic dinner portrait of an original approved adult woman at a luxury hotel terrace or seaside balcony.

She wears a soft gray puff-sleeve dress and delicate jewelry, with any visible luxury-brand motifs treated as replaceable placeholders.

prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: 2000s digital-camera direct flash mixed with warm candle and hotel light, gentle skin shine, cozy nostalgic elegant mood, deep blue evening sky and warm interior reflections.
prompt.technical_specs: Realistic 3:4 flash photography, close-up portrait, natural handheld perspective, visible food, glass, fabric, and hair texture, restrained warm tone, no artificial HDR look.
